headline: Trump renames AI 'Super Intelligence,' signs safety pledge, forms oversight task force
summary: Trump ordered federal agencies to call AI 'Super Intelligence' and hosted AI company leaders who signed a voluntary safety pledge, which was found to contain a misspelling of 'United States.' Trump later created a 'Super Intelligence Force' task force and named his national intelligence chief, Jay Clayton, to lead it.
